systemSlots.use: Brand color — primary buttons, links, active states.
Deeper brand tone — footer / accent band (NOT a black dark-band; church tone stays light).
Eyebrows, small emphasis, secondary highlight (may equal primary).
Alt band / card surface (subtle warm tint).
Text ON a photo/overlay hero (light ink). Used sparingly — see church tone note.
Muted text on a photo/overlay hero.

tokens.autoPairedForegrounds: `--brand-{slot}-fg` are WCAG-AA auto-paired by contrast.ts — do not assign.

modules.name: sermons
modules.use: 설교 — data blocks: recent_sermons, sermon_feature (+ sermon study fields → sermon_magazine).

modules.name: bulletins
modules.use: 주보(weekly bulletin, PDF cover) — data block: recent_bulletins.

modules.name: banners
modules.use: 메인 배너 슬라이더 — data block: banner_slider (category=main/sub). NOT auto-migrated.

modules.name: schedules
modules.use: 예배·모임 시간표 — data block: schedule_board (or static worship_schedule block).

modules.name: newcomers
modules.use: 새가족 — public FORM block: newcomer_form (+ static newcomer_info).

themeEndpoint: PUT /api/v1/theme (themes/routes.ts) — apply the theme FIRST (STEP 1), before composing pages.

blocks.label: 최근 주보

blocks.label: 새가족 안내

blocks.label: 게시판
